name: Cable Seated Wide-Grip Row
steps: Sit upright at a low cable row station with feet braced and knees softly bent.
Take an overhand grip wider than shoulder width on the bar with arms extended forward.
Drive your elbows out and back to pull the bar toward your upper abdomen or lower chest.
Squeeze your shoulder blades briefly, then extend your arms forward under control.
tips: Keep your ribs stacked over your hips throughout the pull.
Keep your shoulders down away from your ears and avoid leaning back with momentum.
